components.css: .ds-film-record { position:relative; width:min(100%,610px); padding:42px; border:1px solid rgba(202,221,255,.32); background:rgba(11,17,25,.9); color:#f1f5f2; box-shadow:0 0 38px rgba(42,240,218,.08),inset 0 0 42px rgba(174,139,255,.04); font-family:Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-film-record::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:-1px; right:-1px; bottom:-1px; height:2px; background:#64e9d1; box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(100,233,209,.55); } .ds-record-code { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding-bottom:16px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(241,245,242,.16); color:rgba(241,245,242,.52); font-size:8px; letter-spacing:.13em; } .ds-record-company { margin:30px 0 0; color:#ff914d; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.16em; } .ds-film-record h3 { margin:9px 0 0; font-size:32px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.05; } .ds-film-record h3 + p { margin:22px 0 0; color:rgba(241,245,242,.7); font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; }

components.name: Registration Rail
components.description: Decorative crosshair rail that establishes the measured contact-sheet coordinate system.
components.css: .ds-registration-rail { position:relative; width:28px; height:320px; border-left:1px solid rgba(241,245,242,.34); background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0 14%,rgba(241,245,242,.3) 14% calc(14% + 1px),transparent calc(14% + 1px) 28%); } .ds-registration-rail span { position:absolute; left:-10px; width:20px; height:20px; border:1px solid rgba(241,245,242,.34); border-radius:50%; } .ds-registration-rail span::before,.ds-registration-rail span::after { content:''; position:absolute; background:rgba(241,245,242,.38); } .ds-registration-rail span::before { left:9px; top:-8px; width:1px; height:34px; } .ds-registration-rail span::after { left:-8px; top:9px; width:34px; height:1px; } .ds-registration-rail span:first-child { top:0; } .ds-registration-rail span:nth-child(2) { top:49%; } .ds-registration-rail span:last-child { bottom:0; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio behaves like an editorial contact sheet laid on a dark inspection table. Engineering evidence is the artwork: project interfaces sit inside translucent optical film, while hairline rules, registration marks, indices, and compact metadata make the composition feel measured rather than ornamental. The visual world is cinematic and spatial, but its purpose is fast evaluation by recruiters.

Density is intentional. Large, narrow display type establishes chapters; compact Manrope text carries facts; and broad areas of near-black preserve focus around the project planes. Mint, violet, and warm orange appear as controlled refractions, never as broad decorative fills. Active Theory informs the spatial confidence and motion, while ambiguous navigation is explicitly excluded: work, résumé, project details, and contact remain visible, semantic actions.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black editorial gallery with off-white type and hairline registration structure.
Project screenshots presented as luminous, translucent film planes rather than generic cards.
Bahianita display typography paired with compact, highly legible Manrope UI and body text.
Mint, violet, and orange accents used as optical signals, indices, and edge light.
Square actions, clipped planes, and precise coordinate-like alignment.
CSS perspective and restrained Framer Motion create depth without gating content.

rules.name: The Refraction Rule
rules.body: Mint, violet, and orange identify signals and depth; they do not become large background fields.

rules.name: The Alpha Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use paper white at full strength for key facts, around 60–78% for explanations, and around 14–34% for registration rules and structural borders.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Bahianita owns identity and chapter-scale statements; Manrope owns facts, controls, project names, and operational detail.

rules.name: The Tall-Type Rule
rules.body: Never replace Bahianita with a generic bold grotesk or stretch Manrope to imitate it; the narrow, irregular display silhouette is foundational.

rules.name: The Registered Edge Rule
rules.body: Major content aligns to the recurring left rails and section insets; do not center ordinary sections merely to fill space.

rules.name: The Edge-Light Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from overlapping planes and illuminated edges; never lift every surface with a soft generic shadow.

rules.name: The Motion-Is-Registration Rule
rules.body: Pointer and scroll motion should reveal how layers relate. It must remain subtle, spring-smoothed, and removable without losing information.

rules.name: The Instrument Geometry Rule
rules.body: Reserve circles for signals and measurement; keep actionable surfaces rectilinear.

dos: Do lead with real project evidence and keep the work, résumé, and contact routes obvious.
Do maintain the near-black ground, warm editorial display type, and restrained three-color refraction system.
Do use semantic sections, headings, navigation, links, lists, and descriptions underneath the spatial composition.
Do preserve 2px optic-mint :focus-visible outlines with clear offset on every immersive link.
Do give meaningful project imagery useful alt text while marking registration marks and purely optical layers decorative.
Do provide the stacked 900px fallback and test that it remains usable at browser zoom and narrow phone widths.
Do honor both useReducedMotion() and prefers-reduced-motion; core content must not depend on tilt, parallax, or the progress beam.
donts: Don't turn the experience into a centered developer headline followed by equal rounded cards.
Don't use large accent-color fills, rainbow gradients, pill-shaped actions, or generic glassmorphism as the primary visual language.
Don't add motion that delays access, creates a hidden navigation model, or changes the reading order.
Don't use circles for routine controls or soften the square film geometry with broad corner radii.
Don't invent project metrics, outcomes, or imagery to make a plane look busier.
Don't preserve desktop absolute positioning on mobile; flatten the structure and keep evidence readable.
